name: Xen ban at Ban Vat
nameVi: Lễ hội Xên bản, bản Vặt
summary: A Thai rite for the village spirit. The heritage monograph says the procession usually runs from 29 Aug to 1 Sep, starts at 8:00 at Vat Hong pagoda, and ends at Dai Yem. A 2026 confirmation of those exact days, separate from the culture week, was not found. Check on arrival.
when: Usually 29 Aug–1 Sep, start 8:00, in the heritage monograph. Check on arrival.
